'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Bill Kafer DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I love Empire so much
* '''Username:''' TacoBill
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
